note: Items the world hands out or a recipe asks for that nobody makes or gathers yet, each with the open issue that gives it a maker. scripts/dev/Check-Makers.js fails on a gap not listed here, and on an entry here that now has a maker or that nothing hands out or asks for any more (#3132). exempt is for named uniques, quest items and what Patrick has set apart as found only (the Ancient Nord burial set), each with why.
